note: net vnet get, and arm resource get on the vnet
net vnet get and net subnet get: used and free IPs per subnet
net subnet get on the private endpoints' subnet
net subnet get …/aks: NICs holding IPs (an AKS node's NIC is no resource of its own)

body.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces'
| mv-expand ip = properties.ipConfigurations
| where tostring(ip.properties.subnet.id) =~ '/subscriptions/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000005b01/resourceGroups/rg-contoso-prod/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/vnet-contoso-prod/subnets/aks'
| summarize ips = count() by holder = coalesce(tostring(properties.privateEndpoint.id), tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id), id)
| order by holder asc

note: net subnet get …/aks: the node pools' scale sets

body.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| mv-expand nic = properties.virtualMachineProfile.networkProfile.networkInterfaceConfigurations
| mv-expand ip = nic.properties.ipConfigurations
| where tostring(ip.properties.subnet.id) =~ '/subscriptions/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000005b01/resourceGroups/rg-contoso-prod/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/vnet-contoso-prod/subnets/aks'
| summarize per_node = count() by holder = id, nodes = toint(sku.capacity), pool = tostring(tags['aks-managed-poolName']), nodeGroup = tolower(resourceGroup)
| join kind=leftouter (resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project cluster = name, nodeGroup = tolower(tostring(properties.nodeResourceGroup))) on nodeGroup
| project holder, nodes, per_node, pool, cluster
| order by holder asc

note: net subnet get …/private-endpoints: the Key Vault endpoint's NIC

| summarize ips = count() by holder = coalesce(tostring(properties.privateEndpoint.id), tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id), id)
